title: Translations
body:
Hi.
I'm increasing the Italian translation of the English text, but it would be a very easier task if
I could do it on a text file with PC, instead of on a Smartphone.
Is this possible?
If yes, where can I find the text file?
Thank you.
Bye
Andrea    :-)

comments.body:
I asked also to Jon if we could work on the strings.xml file directly, instead of using the app. More convenient for massive change, and 'find' capabilities.

Andrea, you should search for 'strings-it' sentence in the repository to get it.

Thanks a lot, I'll search for it as you suggested.
Appeciated.
Andrea   :-)

I think developers of xDrip should let people translate by themselves on their devices (Crowd-sourced translation, Save translation on my phone).

Anyway, I can help with Russian
@filipedanunes and @ANDREAPIPPI Please join [crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/xdrip) and suggest your translations their. Soon, I'll add dynamic screenshots to get a better context.
